cases.title: Record standard visited link to Global History
cases.description: Verify that when a user navigates to a standard HTTP/HTTPS web link, the visited link is successfully recorded in the Global History.

cases.title: Exclude failed navigations from Global History
cases.description: Verify that failed navigations such as connection timeouts or 404 error pages are not recorded as successfully visited links in the Global History.

cases.title: Record Final Destination URL After Single Redirect
cases.description: Navigate to a URL that issues a 301 or 302 redirect to a different target URL and verify that the final destination URL, rather than the intermediary URL, is recorded in the Global History.

cases.title: Record Final Destination URL Across Redirect Chains
cases.description: Navigate to a URL that triggers a multi-step redirect chain (e.g., A -> B -> C) and verify that the ultimate final destination URL (C) is correctly recorded in the Global History.

cases.title: Handle Redirect Loops Without Corrupting History
cases.description: Attempt to navigate to a URL that results in a server redirect loop, and ensure that the browser handles the error gracefully without recording invalid or looping history entries.

cases.title: Launch History Link in Current Window
cases.description: Verify that clicking on a history link successfully launches the target URL in the current browser window.

cases.title: Launch History Link with Modified Opening Action
cases.description: Verify that opening a history link in a new tab or new window via modifier keys or context menu functions correctly.

cases.title: Launch Invalid or Corrupted History Link
cases.description: Verify that attempting to launch a corrupted or malformed URI stored in the history gracefully handles the error without crashing the browser.

cases.title: Delete Single History Entry Successfully
cases.description: Verify that selecting a single history entry and triggering deletion removes the entry from both the UI list and the underlying database.

cases.title: Attempt Deletion of Non-Existent History Entry
cases.description: Verify that attempting to delete a non-existent or already deleted history entry ID handles the operation gracefully without causing application errors.

cases.title: Delete contiguous range of history entries
cases.description: Select a continuous range of multiple history entries using Shift+Click, execute the delete action, and verify that all selected entries are removed from the view and database.

cases.title: Delete discontiguous set of history entries
cases.description: Select multiple non-contiguous history entries using Ctrl+Click, execute the delete action, and verify that all selected entries are successfully deleted and no longer displayed.

cases.title: Attempt deletion with empty selection
cases.description: Trigger the delete action when no history entries are selected and verify that the application handles the empty selection gracefully without errors.

cases.title: Clear Entire Global History
cases.description: Trigger the clear history function on a populated Global History database and verify that all entries are removed and the UI resets correctly.

cases.title: Clear Empty Global History
cases.description: Trigger the clear history function when the Global History is already empty and verify that the system handles the action gracefully without errors.

cases.title: Group History by Day
cases.description: Verify that history items are correctly grouped and displayed under day-based headers when the 'Day' grouping option is selected.

cases.title: Group History by Site
cases.description: Verify that history items are nested and categorized under respective site or domain headers when the 'Site' grouping option is selected.

cases.title: Group History by None
cases.description: Verify that history items are displayed in a flat, ungrouped list when the grouping option is set to 'None'.

cases.title: Dynamic Grouping View Switching
cases.description: Verify that the history view dynamically updates and re-organizes the displayed items seamlessly when switching between Day, Site, and None grouping views.

cases.title: Sort and Reverse-Sort History Columns
cases.description: Verify that clicking history column headers (e.g., Title, URL, Last Visited) sorts the list in ascending order, and clicking again reverse-sorts the list in descending order.

cases.title: Sorting Empty History List
cases.description: Verify that attempting to sort columns when the history list is empty is handled gracefully without causing UI errors or crashes.

cases.title: Resize history columns to show and hide more entry details
cases.description: Verify that dragging the column border of a history list column expands or collapses its width properly, ensuring text truncation or expansion updates dynamically according to the new dimensions.

cases.title: History column resizing boundary limits
cases.description: Verify that history columns respect minimum and maximum width boundaries when dragged excessively, preventing total collapse or infinite expansion beyond the UI window bounds.

cases.title: Show and Hide History Columns via Header Menu
cases.description: Verify that history columns can be successfully shown and hidden using the column header context menu.

cases.title: Prevent Hiding All History Columns
cases.description: Verify that the user cannot hide all columns, ensuring at least a minimum number of visible columns remains.

cases.title: Re-visit site via Back button dropdown menu
cases.description: Navigate through multiple pages, long-click or hold the Back button to display the dropdown history menu, and select a previously visited page to verify successful navigation back to that site.

cases.title: Re-visit site via Forward button dropdown menu
cases.description: After navigating back from a history stack, long-click or hold the Forward button to display the dropdown menu of forward pages, and select a page to verify navigation to that site.

cases.title: Back and Forward dropdown state at session start
cases.description: Open a new browser window or tab where the navigation history stack is empty, and verify that the Back and Forward button dropdown menus are either disabled or empty.

cases.title: Create Empty Session History File for New Browser Window
cases.description: Verify that launching a brand new browser window initializes a fresh, empty session history file.

cases.title: Create Empty Session History File on Browser Restart
cases.description: Verify that restarting the browser without session restore initializes a new, empty session history file.

opinions.feedback: All test cases are well-formulated, highly distinct, and properly cover the requirements without any blocking issues.
All cases are well-structured, thoroughly test the requirements, and accurately map to the provided IDs.

analysis.analysis: R-073: Testable behavior: Visited links are recorded. Boundary: Standard web links versus restricted or internal schemes. Normal path: Click normal HTTP/HTTPS link, verify it appears in Global History. Abnormal path: Failed navigations (404, connection timeout) should not be recorded as successfully visited links. Ambiguity: Does 'visited' require full page load or just navigation initiation? R-074: Testable behavior: Final destination URL recorded after redirect. Boundary: Single redirect vs redirect chains (301, 302, meta-refresh). Normal path: Navigate to URL that 301 redirects, verify final URL in history. Abnormal path: Redirect loops resulting in error. Ambiguity: Are intermediary redirect URLs logged alongside final URL? R-075: Testable behavior: Launching history link in browser window. Boundary: Current tab, new tab, and new window actions. Normal path: Click history item, opens in active tab. Abnormal path: Click corrupted or invalid URI stored in history. Ambiguity: Default opening behavior (same vs new tab). R-076: Testable behavior: Single history entry deletion. Boundary: Deleting oldest, newest, or currently active page. Normal path: Select one history item, trigger delete, verify removal from list and database. Abnormal path: Deleting non-existent entry ID. Ambiguity: Does deletion remove associated cache/cookies or just history entry? R-077: Testable behavior: Multiple history entries deletion. Boundary: Discontiguous selection, range selection (Shift+Click), all selected. Normal path: Multi-select entries, delete, verify all removed and UI updated. Abnormal path: Deleting empty selection. Ambiguity: Handling partial failure if some entries are locked. R-078: Testable behavior: Clearing entire Global History. Boundary: Clearing empty history vs large history database. Normal path: Trigger clear history, verify 0 entries remain and UI resets. Abnormal path: Clear during active database write operation. Ambiguity: Time range specification (clear all vs clear last hour). R-079: Testable behavior: Grouping history by Day, Site, or None. Boundary: Switch between group views dynamically. Normal path: Select 'Site' grouping, verify items nest under respective domain headers. Abnormal path: Invalid grouping parameter. Ambiguity: Definition of 'Site' (e.g., domain vs full origin). R-080: Testable behavior: Sorting and reverse-sorting history columns. Boundary: Columns like Title, URL, Last Visited. Normal path: Click column header to sort ascending, click again for descending. Abnormal path: Sorting empty history list. Ambiguity: Null value handling during sort. R-081: Testable behavior: Resizing history columns. Boundary: Minimum and maximum column width limits. Normal path: Drag column border to expand/collapse width, verify truncation/expansion of text. Abnormal path: Dragging beyond window boundary. Ambiguity: Persistence of column widths across sessions. R-082: Testable behavior: Showing and hiding history columns. Boundary: Minimum number of visible columns. Normal path: Right-click header, uncheck column, verify it disappears. Abnormal path: Attempting to hide all columns. Ambiguity: Default columns on fresh profile. R-083: Testable behavior: Re-visiting sites via Back/Forward dropdown. Boundary: Start of session (empty stack) vs deep navigation stack. Normal path: Long-click Back button, select entry from dropdown menu, verify navigation. Abnormal path: Selecting an expired cache entry from dropdown. Ambiguity: Maximum number of items in dropdown list. R-084: Testable behavior: Creation of new empty session history file on restart/new window. Boundary: Fresh profile vs session restore. Normal path: Launch new window, verify new history file initialized. Abnormal path: Disk write failure when creating file. Ambiguity: File naming convention and storage location.
